description: This file contains test code that inspects a data structure 'StandardLoggingPayload', retrieves its fields recursively, and compares them against documented entries in a markdown documentation file. It is designed to verify that all fields of the data structure are documented.

methods.name: get_all_fields(type_dict, prefix="")
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all fields from a TypedDict and its nested types, returning a set of field names.

methods.name: test_standard_logging_payload_documentation()
methods.description: Retrieves all fields from 'StandardLoggingPayload', reads a markdown documentation file, extracts documented fields, and checks for any undocumented fields, raising an error if discrepancies are found.
